body:
PagerDuty Bot: PAGER — GPU queue backlog spike detected in eu-west-1 (service: inference-hosted). alert_id=PD-90412
Mike (oncall): seeing 502s and pod Pending on gpunodepool-eu-west. Dashboard shows queue length x3 baseline.
Sarah Ops: CPU ok but GPU utilization 98% on pool. Autoscaler not adding nodes, maxNodes=12.
Carlos (eng-sre): autoscaler logs show 'scale target reached: current=12 max=12' and then 'no more capacity available'.
Mike (oncall): rough impact? customers?
Tom (support): 3 paying customers saw errors ~ 2m ago, logs show requests queued then timed out. Incident severity P1 if payments impacted.
Nina (ml-eng): Models with long context are saturating KV cache; a bunch of 256k tokens requests driving throughput down. Can we reject large seqs as soft-fail?
Jess (product): Need mitigation that keeps SLAs for top-tier customers. Prioritize them.
Carlos (eng-sre): Requesting manual node cap raise to 18 — need approval from infra lead + finance for burst capacity. Who can authorize now?
Sarah Ops: I can approve emergency short-term raise within budget cap for EU. I need ops-oncall + infra lead to execute.
Mike (oncall): I'm authorizing an emergency bump while we triage. Please note ops will open a billing exception.
Infra Bot: Manual node increase requires operator intervention. Run: `kubectl scale nodepool gpunodepool-eu-west --nodes=18` (operator only).
Carlos (eng-sre): prepping command, will coordinate with infra. Also starting triage: enable prefix caching eviction and reduce batch size for long seq models.
Nina (ml-eng): Quick patch: set model_max_seq to 16k for heavy models and route large contexts to degraded CPU-only path. Will push policy change to router.
Mike (oncall): @InfraOps who's available to run operator command?
Sarah Ops: @Carlos you have green light from me. @Jess please confirm top-customer priority list.
Jess (product): Top customers: AcmeInc, BrightApps, Flowlytics. Mark AcmeInc as highest priority.
Carlos (eng-sre): infra lead confirmed on call. Preparing to apply. Will run operator now and watch events.
Infra Bot: operator action initiated by Carlos. action_id=op-7721
Carlos (eng-sre): running `kubectl annotate nodepool gpunodepool-eu-west emergency-bump=true` then `gcloud beta compute node-pools resize ... --nodes=18` (internal CLI). Posting logs:

```
[12:03:05] resizing nodepool gpunodepool-eu-west current=12 target=18
[12:03:18] provisioning 6 new nodes
[12:05:42] nodes joined cluster: gpu-18-a,gpu-18-b,gpu-18-c
[12:06:10] autoscaler reconciled, new maxNodes=18
```

Mike (oncall): patching router to favor smaller models for public traffic during ramp.
Nina (ml-eng): pushed routing override: `route_policy: prefer=fast-quant` for non-priority accounts.
Tom (support): AcmeInc reports degraded latency but no errors after 12:07. BrightApps still seeing some timeouts.
Carlos (eng-sre): queue length falling from 450 -> 70 over 6 minutes. Throttle rate down to 5% of requests in pending bucket.
Sarah Ops: Good. Confirmed new nodes are stable, no OOMs. GPU driver versions match.
Mike (oncall): How did autoscaler fail to scale earlier? Need root cause next.
Carlos (eng-sre): early evidence: cloud provider hit a per-project GPU quota for eu-west. Autoscaler was blocked by quota after hitting 12. Our controller didn't surface quota errors clearly, treated as 'reached max'.
Nina (ml-eng): also saw a traffic pattern spike from a test suite hitting long-context paths. We've added rate-limits on client-facing endpoints.
Jess (product): Customer impact: AcmeInc saw 12% request failure, BrightApps 6%, Flowlytics 2%. Logged in support tickets.
Tom (support): I've opened tickets and notified account reps. Will follow up with remediation ETA.
Sarah Ops: Finance approved one-off burst; ops to file CAPEX/chargeback.
Mike (oncall): Postmortem items: 1) surface quota errors in autoscaler, 2) per-tenant long-seq rate limits, 3) test harness gating for long-context smoke tests, 4) automation for emergency node bump.
Carlos (eng-sre): assigning follow-ups: autoscaler error visibility (Carlos), quota monitoring alert (Sarah Ops), router safeguards (Nina), billing automation (Jess).
PagerDuty Bot: Incident incident-2026-04-03-GPU-QUOTA created. Severity: P2 (downgraded).
Mike (oncall): Wrapping up — queue normal, nodes stable, customers notified. Leave thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
Sarah Ops: I'll schedule cross-team postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Nina (ml-eng): saved temporary routing changes as patch; will revert after postmortem.
Carlos (eng-sre): final stats: peak queue 470, peak GPU util 99%, downtime-equivalent for top-customer ~2m.
Tom (support): closing incident but keeping tickets open until customers confirm.
Jess (product): Thanks everyone.
Mike (oncall): Good job. Ending active ops at 12:24.
